title: A Rocket Launch Turned the Sky Into a Glowing Jellyfish

scenes.text: A rocket launch just painted a giant jellyfish across the sky.
On October thirteenth, a Falcon 9 lifted off from Florida before sunrise.
It was carrying supplies to the space station.
High up, the exhaust was still in direct sunlight.
Down on the ground, it was still dark.
So the spreading plume glowed against the black sky. A rocket, a sunrise, and a jellyfish.

description:
A rocket launch just painted a giant jellyfish across the sky.
A Falcon 9 carrying a Dragon cargo ship to the space station lifted off before sunrise on October 13, 2026, and its plume lit up the eastern United States.
Have you ever seen one in person?
